name: default initial state and first tick
comment: Without an initial HLC, the clock starts at (0, 0, a). Since now (1000) > 0, tick adopts physicalTime=1000 and counter=0.

name: tick advances physicalTime and resets counter
comment: When now (1001) > last.physicalTime (1000), physicalTime advances to 1001 and counter resets from 5 to 0.

name: tick at same physicalTime increments counter monotonically
comment: When now == last.physicalTime, physicalTime stays at 1000 and each local tick increments counter by 1.

name: tick with wall clock moving backwards preserves physicalTime
comment: When now (4000) < last.physicalTime (5000), the HLC must never regress: it keeps physicalTime=5000 and increments counter.

name: tick counter overflow at 99999 carries into physicalTime
comment: Incrementing counter past 99999 carries +1 into physicalTime (1000 -> 1001) and resets counter to 0.

name: recv branch 1: pt equals both last and remote (remote counter higher)
comment: pt = max(1000, 1000, 1000) = 1000 matches both last and remote, so counter = max(3, 7) + 1 = 8.

name: recv branch 2: pt equals last only (local ahead of now and remote)
comment: pt = max(1500, 2000, 1800) = 2000 matches only last.physicalTime, so counter = last.counter + 1 = 5 (ignoring remote's larger counter 10).

name: recv branch 3: pt equals remote only (remote ahead of now and last)
comment: pt = max(1000, 1000, 2000) = 2000 matches only remote.physicalTime, so counter = remote.counter + 1 = 8.

name: recv branch 4: now strictly greater than last and remote resets counter
comment: pt = max(5000, 2000, 3000) = 5000 comes strictly from wall clock now, so counter resets to 0.

name: recv counter overflow at 99999 carries into physicalTime
comment: Remote is ahead at (2000, 99999); remote.counter + 1 = 100000 overflows into physicalTime=2001, counter=0.

name: recv rejects remote exceeding maxDriftMs without mutating clock
comment: Remote physicalTime 61001 > now (1000) + default maxDriftMs (60000), so receive throws CLOCK_SKEW and leaves last at 1000:00002:a; the subsequent tick advances to 1000:00003:a.

name: recv at exact maxDriftMs boundary is accepted
comment: The skew guard rejects strictly greater (> now + maxDriftMs). At 61000 == 1000 + 60000, receive succeeds.

name: recv keeps local nodeId when adopting remote timestamp
comment: The local clock always stamps its own nodeId (node_alpha) after receiving from another node (node_zeta).

name: realistic 13-digit epoch timestamps
comment: Verifies 13-digit millisecond epoch formatting and multi-step tick + recv sequence.
